Presentation04 / 20

Two ways to say it

have not → haven’t

我還沒洗碗。

I have not washed the dishes yet.

I haven’t washed the dishes yet.

has not → hasn’t

他還沒洗碗。

He has not washed the dishes yet.

He hasn’t washed the dishes yet.
